resolution_source: Election Commission of India official results (results.eci.gov.in), party-wise seat tally at first full declaration of all 403 seats
independence_attestation: No betting odds, prediction-market prices or forecast-aggregator numbers were fetched or consulted during this research pass. Honesty caveat: the engine's config files and India ledger (which contain the engine's own M2/M3 probabilities) were read earlier in this session for integration work; the number below was built base-rate-first from the cited research sources, and neither market prices nor the engine's own instrument outputs are averaged in.

base_rate_used.reference_class: Incumbent Indian state governments (post-2014 nationalized era) remaining the largest force: 22 of 46 elections in the engine's own N=46 retrodiction set (~48%); winning an outright majority is a stricter event. UP-specific: no government was re-elected 1989-2017; BJP 2022 broke the rotation
base_rate_used.source: Psephos multistate retrodiction report (N=46, incumbent retention 22/46); UP electoral history

evidence: Recent vote-share polls (all unrated agencies): Matrize 2026-09-29 NDA 44 / INDIA 38; Spick Media 2026-09-13 NDA 42.1 / INDIA 39.7; Survey Sarva 2026-09-10 NDA 38.7 / INDIA 40.8; Vote Vibe 2026-08-25 NDA 41.8 / INDIA 38.7 - three of four show NDA ahead by 2-6 points
2024 LS counter-signal: INDIA (SP+INC) beat NDA in UP (43 of 80 seats); but Nov-2024 bypolls went 7-2 to BJP+RLD, suggesting assembly-level dynamics reverted

Opposition coordination friction: SP-Congress seat-sharing unresolved as of Oct 2026 (Congress eyeing 125+ seats, SP signalling far fewer; public 'big brother' sniping); a fragmented INDIA vote is the NDA's single biggest structural asset
BJP machine advancing: Amit Shah to launch the UP campaign at the state executive meeting 2026-10-30/31; RLD confirmed in the NDA
Possible Akhilesh-Chandrashekhar Azad (ASP) tie-up reported - would consolidate Dalit votes against the NDA and is the main live downside tripwire
questions.strongest_opposing_case: The INDIA bloc beat the NDA statewide only two years ago (2024 LS), the three-polls-ahead signal comes entirely from unrated agencies with undisclosed methodology (one of four actually shows INDIA ahead), UP's long rotation habit was broken only once, and a sealed SP-INC-ASP combination with efficient transfers could turn a 2-4 point vote deficit into a seat majority the way 2024's coordination did. A 42-39 split with BSP collapse redistributing unpredictably does not guarantee 202 of 403 seats.
questions.reasoning_summary: Base ~0.45 (incumbent retention in the nationalized era; majority stricter, UP rotation history argues lower, BJP's 2022 re-election and organizational depth argue higher). Adjust up for the poll lead (3 of 4 unrated polls, NDA +2 to +6), the 7-2 bypoll sweep, and visible SP-INC seat-sharing friction; adjust down for the 2024 LS result (INDIA won the state), unrated-poll quality, and the possible ASP consolidation. FPTP in a bipolar UP converts a sustained 3-4 point lead into a seat majority more often than not. Final: 0.55.
